Documentation/ HEPkit

HEPkit

High-energy physics tools for symbolic and numerical calculations.

Models, Feynman diagrams, generation, CFFs, tensor reduction, and kinematics are available directly in this namespace, for example hepkit.FeynmanDiagram. hepkit.oneloop provides symbolic one-loop reduction, with scalar master evaluation available in native builds. Exact parametric and Laporta IBP solving through hepkit.IBPFamily is available in native and Pyodide builds.

Related modules

  • One-loop reduction and master integrals
  • Vacuum integrals with Vakint
  • Integration-by-parts families, rules, and solutions
  • Exact definite integration
  • Sector decomposition
  • RustRed generation
  • Numerical loop integration

See the module overview above for IBP availability in the selected build.

Amplitude A coherent sum of amputated, unintegrated Feynman-diagram operators
AmplitudeError Invalid amplitude, conjugation, or external-state sum.
AmplitudeLeg One physical external state of a symbolic amplitude.
Axis A Cartesian axis used to specify spatial rotations.
Boost A proper Lorentz boost specified by a three-velocity beta

CffError Failure while constructing a Cross-Free Family representation.
